author: Mark Atwood
text: wqaa.9 research: NLnet calls reopen 2026-09-03 with deadline 2026-11-03 12:00 CEST (hard). NGI Zero is transitioning to the new Open Internet Stack programme - frame the proposal for the new programme naming and check the call-specific guide for applicants when it publishes. Note their Generative AI policy requires disclosure if AI assists proposal writing.
